values: 赴印度商务签材料清单 / India Business Visa Document Checklist

Word 清单要求
Word checklist requirement

Excel C列对应项
Excel column C mapping

卡点/待确认
Blockers / to confirm

邀请信原件
Original invitation letter

英文公司信头纸；包含开具日期、申请人姓名、护照号、职务、中方公司名、出访时间、访问目的、印方公司名和地址；落款含邀请人姓名、职位、公司名、邮箱、电话，并亲笔签名。
Printed on English company letterhead; must include issue date, applicant name, passport number, position, Chinese company name, travel dates, visit purpose, Indian company name and address; closing section must include inviter name, title, company name, email, phone, and handwritten signature.

前置材料：先于派遣函/行程单最终版
Prerequisite: before finalizing dispatch letter and itinerary

需确认是否必须原件；日期/访问目的变更会牵动派遣函和行程单。
Confirm whether original is required; any date or purpose change may require revising the dispatch letter and itinerary.

印方公司注册证明
Indian company registration proof

Certificate of Incorporation 复印件 1 份；如有更名证书也提供；或 PAN Card 复印件 1 份。
One copy of Certificate of Incorporation; include name-change certificate if applicable; or one copy of PAN Card.

前置材料：与邀请函一起索取
Prerequisite: request together with invitation letter

Excel 未列，需向 agency 确认是否必须及由谁提供。
Not listed in Excel; confirm with agency whether required and who provides it.

中方公司材料
Chinese company documents

英文公司信头纸；包含派遣函日期、申请人姓名、护照号、身份证号、职务、年薪、访问目的及时间、印方公司名及地址、按时回国说明、费用承担说明；负责人亲笔签名并加盖公章。
Printed on English company letterhead; include dispatch date, applicant name, passport number, Chinese ID number, position, annual salary, visit purpose and dates, Indian company name and address, return-to-China statement, expense coverage statement; signed by responsible person and stamped with company chop.

需等邀请函/访问日期/印方公司信息确认后出具
Issue after invitation letter, visit dates, and Indian company details are confirmed

年薪、访问目的、日期、印方信息需与其他材料一致；变更后可能重开盖章。
Salary, purpose, dates, and Indian company details must match other documents; changes may require reissue and restamping.

中方公司材料
Chinese company documents

中方营业执照复印件及翻译件
Chinese business license copy and translation

营业执照复印件加盖公章，并提供英文翻译件。
Stamped copy of business license plus English translation.

印业执照（应为营业执照）
Business license (Excel typo)

可并行，但需公司配合盖章
Can be prepared in parallel; requires company stamp

需确认翻译件格式、是否需盖章、是否需翻译公司章。
Confirm translation format and whether company/translation stamp is required.

中方公司材料
Chinese company documents

Proforma 信息详情表
Proforma information form

完整填写；不适用项填 N/A；负责人亲笔签名并加盖公章。
Complete all fields; use N/A where not applicable; signed by responsible person and stamped.

需等邀请方/访问目的/日期基本确定后填写
Fill after inviting party, visit purpose, and dates are mostly confirmed

需 agency 提供最新版模板；字段不清会卡。
Agency must provide latest template; unclear fields may block progress.

中方公司材料
Chinese company documents

需体现年收入且年收入大于 25 万元；加盖公章并由负责人签名。
Must show annual income above RMB 250,000; stamped and signed by responsible person.

应与派遣信同步准备
Prepare together with dispatch letter

Excel 未列；年收入门槛及证明措辞需公司确认。
Not listed in Excel; company must confirm salary threshold and wording.

在线申请表
Online application form

在线完整填写；不带 * 的项目也需填写；完成后打印并在下方签名，签名字迹与护照签名一致。
Complete online form fully, including fields without *; print after completion and sign at the bottom; signature must match passport signature.

先生成 Temporary ID，正式提交前建议 agency 复核
Generate Temporary ID first; agency review recommended before final submission

正式提交后通常不可修改；需确认是否由 agency 统一检查后提交。
Usually cannot be modified after final submission; confirm whether agency will review before submission.

白底彩色照片 2 张
Two white-background color photos

近 6 个月；50*50mm；与上传照片一致；露出五官，不能露牙、不能戴眼镜。
Taken within last 6 months; 50*50mm; same as uploaded photo; full facial features visible; no teeth showing and no glasses.

可并行准备
Can be prepared in parallel

需确认电子版/纸质版规格是否一致，照片不合格会返工。
Confirm digital and printed photo specs are aligned; non-compliant photo may require retake.

护照原件及复印件
Original passport and copies

护照有效期不少于 6 个月，至少 2 页空白页；个人信息页复印件 2 份；签证页和盖章页 1 份；如有旧护照，也提供旧护照原件及相关复印件。
Passport valid for at least 6 months with at least 2 blank pages; two copies of bio page; one copy of visa/stamp pages; old passport original and copies if applicable.

面签/递交前必须准备
Must be ready before interview/submission

递交后护照原件会被占用；旧护照要求需确认。
Passport will be held after submission; confirm old passport requirement.

包含截至目前所有工作及教育经历。
Include all work and education history up to present.

可并行准备
Can be prepared in parallel

需与在线申请表、在职证明中的经历一致。
Must be consistent with online form and employment certificate.

最高学历毕业证公证书
Notarial certificate of highest diploma

申请人/公证处
Applicant/notary office

最高学历毕业证公证书原件及复印件；公证需英文翻译。
Original and copy of notarized highest diploma; notarization must include English translation.

可能需先准备学历原件，再做公证
May require original diploma before notarization

Word 要公证书而不只是原件；办理周期和原件保管风险需确认。
Word requires notarized certificate, not merely original diploma; processing time and original-document custody risk need confirmation.

无犯罪记录证明公证书
Notarial certificate of no criminal record

申请人/公安机关/公证处
Applicant/public security authority/notary office

无犯罪证明公证书原件及复印件；公证需英文翻译。
Original and copy of notarized no-criminal-record certificate; notarization must include English translation.

无犯罪证明
No criminal record certificate

先取得无犯罪记录证明，再办理公证/英文翻译
Obtain no-criminal-record certificate first, then notarization/English translation

北京办理可能需居住证/居住卡/工作居住证；证明出具后还要公证，周期不确定。
Beijing application may require residence permit/card or work residence permit; notarization after issuance adds uncertain timeline.

覆盖整个印度行程；写明城市、拜访公司名称、商务会谈内容，并由申请人亲笔签名。
Cover the whole India itinerary; state cities, visited company names, business meeting content; signed by applicant.

需等邀请函/访问日期/城市确认后最终定稿
Finalize after invitation letter, visit dates, and cities are confirmed

与邀请函、派遣函、在线表日期和目的必须一致。
Must match invitation letter, dispatch letter, and online form dates/purpose.

个人银行流水
Personal bank statement

递交前 7 天内打印的近 6 个月工资卡流水，余额不低于 10 万元。
Six-month salary-card bank statement printed within 7 days before submission; balance not less than RMB 100,000.

临近递交前打印
Print shortly before submission

余额门槛、工资卡定义、隐私边界需确认；打印太早可能失效。
Confirm balance threshold, salary-card definition, and privacy boundary; printing too early may invalidate it.

身份证正反面复印件
Copy of both sides of Chinese ID card

身份证正反面打印在同一张纸。
Front and back sides printed on one sheet.

可并行准备
Can be prepared in parallel

Excel 未列；彩色单面打印口径已确认。
Not listed in Excel; color single-sided printing rule should be followed.

商务材料清单
Business document checklist

Word 仅列名称，未展开格式要求。
Word only lists the item name; no detailed format requirement.

递交前随材料包整理
Prepare with final submission package

需 agency 提供模板或确认是否就是当前 Word 清单。
Agency should provide template or confirm whether current Word list is the checklist.

信息便签条
Information note slip

包含个人姓名、印度公司名、在职公司名、个人电话及邮箱。
Include applicant name, Indian company name, current employer name, applicant phone and email.

递交前准备
Prepare before submission

需确认格式/是否手写/是否可打印。
Confirm format, handwritten vs printed requirement.

上传材料并预约面签
Upload documents and schedule interview

在线表完成后，根据系统/agency流程上传或提交材料并预约面签。
After completing online form, upload or submit documents and schedule interview according to system/agency process.

填完之后，上传所有材料，约面签时间
After filling, upload all materials and schedule interview

需所有关键材料齐备后执行
Execute only after key documents are ready

官网 regular/paper visa 更偏向线下提交 supporting documents；需确认是否存在完整线上材料预审。
Official regular/paper visa flow appears to rely more on offline supporting-document submission; confirm whether full online document pre-review exists.

所有材料彩色单面打印
Color single-sided printing of all documents

所有递交材料需彩色单面打印，不可装订。
All submission documents must be printed in color, single-sided, and not bound/stapled.

所有材料彩打
Color print all materials

面签/递交前最后整理
Final package preparation before interview/submission

打印版本需与在线表/邀请函/派遣函最终版一致。
Printed versions must match final online form, invitation letter, and dispatch letter.

Interview / 面签递交
Interview / in-person submission

携带全部必须材料原件、复印件、打印申请表及护照原件，按预约前往 IVAC/使馆递交/面签。
Bring all required originals, copies, printed application form, and original passport to IVAC/Embassy according to appointment.

当天才可能完整审验纸质 supporting documents；材料不符会影响出签周期。
Paper supporting documents may only be fully checked on the submission day; non-compliance may affect visa issuance timeline.
